verdict.rationale: Appwrite provides file/data delete APIs (appwrite-docs-10) and self-hosting for full control over data location (appwrite-docs-24, appwrite-docs-14), which give some data control levers, but there is no explicit documentation on retention policies, automated deletion schedules, data export/erasure workflows, or GDPR-style right-to-be-forgotten tooling for AI-native use cases. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy controls, automated/scheduled deletion or TTL settings, documented data export/erasure workflow, and compliance-specific deletion guarantees (e.g., GDPR/CCPA erasure) tied to AI usage.
